identity.one_liner: 拉取解析 MySQL binlog 并推送变更数据到 Kafka 等 sink 的服务器
identity.review: dolphinbeat 是一个高可用 binlog 采集服务器，读取 MySQL/MariaDB 的 binlog，解析增量变更后推送到 Kafka 或 Stdout 等可扩展 sink。支持 GTID、failover 平滑切换、断点续传、库表过滤规则、Prometheus 风格指标和 HTTP API。源库需开启 ROW 格式 binlog；Kafka 数据以 Protobuf 编码，业务需用客户端库解码。
highlights: 支持 MySQL 与 MariaDB 源，支持 GTID 与非 GTID，GTID 下可在 MySQL failover 后继续工作
提供 Kafka 和 Stdout 两种官方 sink，用户可实现自定义 sink，支持基于库表的过滤规则
支持断点恢复与主备选举模式，提供 HTTP API 与 Prometheus 风格指标
use_cases: 将 MySQL 增量变更数据推送入 Kafka 供业务流处理
需要断点恢复与 failover 容错的 binlog 订阅管道
通过 HTTP API/指标监控 binlog 采集状态

db_verdicts.quote: This is a high available server that pulls MySQL binlog, parses binlog and pushs incremental update data into different sinks. ／ * Supports MySQL and MariaDB. ／ * Supports MySQL failover: if using GTID, `dolphinbeat` can work smoothly even if MySQL failover. ／ * Supports MySQL DDL: `dolphinbeat` can parse DDL statement and replay DDL upon it's own schema data in memory.
* Supports MySQL and MariaDB. ／ > If your source database is MariaDB, please add `-e FLAVOR='mariadb'` arg.

For this, you'll need to start all participating Spilos with identical `etcd <https://github.com/coreos/etcd>`__ addresses and cluster names. ／ Spilo is currently evolving: Its creators are working on a Postgres operator that would make it simpler to deploy scalable Postgres clusters in a Kubernetes environment, and also do maintenance tasks. Spilo would serve as an essential building block for this. There is already a `Helm chart <https://github.com/kubernetes/charts/tree/master/incubator/patroni>`__ that relies on Spilo and Patroni to provision a five-node PostgreSQL HA cluster in a Kubernetes+Google Compute Engine environment. (The Helm chart deploys Spilo Docker images, not just "bare" Patroni.) ／ Spilo's setup assumes that you've correctly configured a load balancer (HAProxy, ELB, Google load balancer) that directs client connections to the master. There are two ways to achieve this: A) if the load balancer relies on the status code to distinguish between the healthy and failed nodes (like ELB), then one needs to configure it to poll the API URL; otherwise, B) you can use callback scripts to change the load balancer configuration dynamically.

classification.eco_why: 内容为数据库设计教学笔记与文档，未提供任何工具或组件

audit.evidence: Useful tips for designing a robust database schema. This guide is more of a decision reference (1) for people wanting to design better database schemas for startups (2). ／ - Decision reference: You will probably come across any one of the problems below when designing database schema (e.g. should I use `JSONB`? How do I design `tagging` schema? How do I keep historical records?) and be presented with different options and trade-offs. If two standards are equal (should table name be singular or plural), then it's up to you to pick one and make it a standard and keeping it consistent. Rather than giving you a `it depends` answer, this guide is meant to share the `what-ifs`, that is the decision I made, and the outcome. Yes, the codes are actually being written and used in different applications I wrote. You don't have to agree with the approaches - I used to take some of the more complex approaches (for the sake of _best practice_), but over time I realised that it is unnecessary. Simple is best. ／ - Startups: A lot of startups starts by using ORMs or frameworks that provides a lot of convenience when it comes to dealing with database. If you are thinking _hey, we need to be agile, that's why we are okay introducing some technical debts_ let me tell you something, you can be both fast and produce quality work (not compromising database design). Most of the time, when new features are being introduced, or when new situation aroses (e.g. analytics are not accurate, because we did not store timestamp with timezones in database, using integer id instead of uuid, and people start _hacking_ your system, etc), the application just won't cut it anymore. The last thing I want to live with is a poorly designed database schema. You can switch language and frameworks for your frontend/backend servers, but if you design your database wrongly, you have to live with it. Also, I mentioned `startups` because my knowledge on database design is limited to a user scale of `<5m`. Also, the approach taken by larger companies might vary, and the technology used might differ as they are focusing a lot on performance, reliability and running databases across the world. For this guide, we are talking specifically about `mysql` and `postgres`, and probably just running them in cloud providers like AWS/Google Cloud.

identity.one_liner: Postgres 命令行管理工具，实时观测统计与排障
identity.review: pgCenter 是一个类 top 界面的命令行工具，实时读取 PostgreSQL 各类统计视图（pg_stat_activity、pg_stat_statements、等待事件等），并提供进程级 CPU/IO 统计、配置文件查看与重载、日志查看、统计录制回放等功能。面向 Postgres DBA 用于运行时监控与排障，支持 Linux，可通过 Docker 或 DEB/RPM/APK 包安装。
highlights: 提供类 top 界面实时监控 Postgres 统计与每后端进程 CPU/IO 指标
支持录制 Postgres 统计到文件并通过 pgcenter report 回放做事后分析
支持查看/编辑配置文件、重载服务、查看日志与等待事件分析
use_cases: DBA 运行时实时排查慢查询与资源瓶颈
将统计录制后做事后（post-mortem）分析
查看等待事件与 VACUUM/REINDEX 等操作进度

db_verdicts.quote: pgCenter is a command-line admin tool for observing and troubleshooting Postgres. ／ pgCenter's main goal is to help Postgres DBA working with statistics and provide a convenient way to observe Postgres in runtime. ／ pgCenter supports a wide range of PostgreSQL versions, despite the difference in statistics between each version. If pgCenter is unable to read a particular stat, it will show a descriptive error message.

classification.eco_why: pgCenter 是为 Postgres 运维服务的客户端管理工具，自身不存储业务数据

identity.one_liner: PostgreSQL 专用可视化数据库建模平台，从模型生成 SQL
identity.review: pgModeler 是面向 PostgreSQL 的多平台可视化建模工具，用于创建表、视图、关系等数据库对象模型并生成 SQL 脚本，提供模型校验功能。适合需要以图形方式设计或维护 PostgreSQL schema 的开发者、DBA 与教学场景。基于 C++/Qt 构建，社区版遵循 GPLv3，商业版提供逆向工程、模型比对同步等附加功能。
highlights: 可视化建模：通过拖拽界面管理表、视图、关系、函数等 PostgreSQL 对象
从可视化模型生成 SQL 脚本，保留 PostgreSQL 兼容的对象定义
校验工具可在部署前检测建模不一致、引用断开与依赖问题
use_cases: 新建系统时的可视化数据库设计与 schema 工程
教学或开发工作流中的 PostgreSQL schema 设计
维护既有复杂数据库基础设施时的模型化管理

identity.one_liner: 面向Web3的开源多链数据与预言机平台
identity.review: DIA 是一个面向 Web3 的开源数据平台，用于从链上交易和中心化交易所 API 采集、校验并分发金融数据源（资产价格、借贷利率等）。数据可通过预言机智能合约、REST API 或 GraphQL 交付到 25+ 条 L1/L2 区块链网络，供 DeFi/TradFi 智能合约集成使用。仓库主要包含 Go 服务与 CI/CD 流水线说明，未涉及传统数据库适配。

identity.one_liner: Postgres 高可用集群工具，提供冗余与自动故障转移
identity.review: Yoke 用 Go 编写，通过在主备节点上以子进程方式运行 postgres 并借助 ssh 与 rsync 同步数据，实现 Postgres 集群的冗余、自动故障转移与自动恢复。适用于需要自管小型 Postgres 高可用集群的运维人员；要求三节点（主/备/监控）部署，并提供 yokeadm CLI 做节点状态查看与降级操作。
highlights: 提供 Postgres 集群的冗余与自动故障转移
主备节点以子进程方式运行 postgres，配合 rsync 同步

use_cases: 为 Postgres 搭建主备高可用集群

通过 CLI 对集群节点做状态巡检与手动降级
